derivation: from a presumed prolonged form of G2054 (ἔρις);

occurrences.text: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
